work.objective: Reproduce the proven renderer raw-input Backspace implementation and independently verify it with a correctly structured multiline Expect PTY gate.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.
Only modify the four allowlisted files; no Ink, dependency, lockfile, Marshal-state, commit, push, publication, network or subagent changes.

Reproduce the R6 semantics from the frozen requirements without reading prior run artifacts or worktrees: useLayoutEffect registers renderer addInputHandler before paint, consumes only recognized unmodified Backspace, calls TextareaRenderable.deleteCharBackward exactly once, and cleans up.

Inspect installed @opentui/react/core APIs and use renderer addInputHandler/removeInputHandler with correct cleanup. Consume only plain legacy DEL/BS and supported unmodified kitty Backspace encodings.
Never slice or reconstruct JavaScript text for deletion; call TextareaRenderable.deleteCharBackward(). Prevent duplicate parsed/focused handling.
Printable fallback must reject modifier/control/editing/navigation keys while preserving ASCII, CJK and emoji.
Worker checks may use unit/OpenTUI vitest, CLI typecheck/build and git diff --check only; native Bun/PTY belongs to verifier.
If denied, do not retry the denied path; use an allowed equivalent or report blocked.
context: Direct Bun probes established that raw DEL reaches addInputHandler, changes ZXQ to ZX, and Enter renders a submitted ZX message.
The prior verification was a false negative because its braced Expect pattern/action clauses were written on one physical line.
Verifier requires ready → ZXQ → raw DEL → submitted ZX → Ctrl+C EOF with each Expect branch on its own line.
